title: 第 K 条最小指令
summary: 从原点到 destination，只能向右 H 或向下 V，所有可行指令按字典序排列，返回第 k 条。
insight: H 的字典序小于 V。逐位尝试 H，以 H 开头的后缀数量为组合数 C(h+v-1,v)；k 落在该区间就选 H，否则跳过并选 V。
pitfalls: destination[0] 是 V 数量，destination[1] 是 H 数量
选择 V 时要减去所有以 H 开头的方案数

solutions.title: 组合序列反排名
solutions.idea: 按每个前缀包含的方案数量定位第 k 条路径。
steps: 两种字符都剩余时计算 startWithH=C(h+v-1,v)
k<=startWithH 追加 H，否则追加 V 并令 k-=startWithH；最后补齐剩余字符

code.java: class Solution { private long combination(int n,int choose){choose=Math.min(choose,n-choose);long answer=1;for(int i=1;i<=choose;i++)answer=answer*(n-i+1)/i;return answer;}public String kthSmallestPath(int[] destination,int k){int vertical=destination[0],horizontal=destination[1];StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();while(horizontal>0&&vertical>0){long startWithH=combination(horizontal+vertical-1,vertical);if(k<=startWithH){answer.append('H');horizontal--;}else{answer.append('V');vertical--;k-=startWithH;}}while(horizontal-->0)answer.append('H');while(vertical-->0)answer.append('V');return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun combination(n:Int,chooseValue:Int):Long{val choose=minOf(chooseValue,n-chooseValue);var answer=1L;for(i in 1..choose)answer=answer*(n-i+1)/i;return answer};fun kthSmallestPath(destination:IntArray,kValue:Int):String{var vertical=destination[0];var horizontal=destination[1];var k=kValue.toLong();val answer=StringBuilder();while(horizontal>0&&vertical>0){val startWithH=combination(horizontal+vertical-1,vertical);if(k<=startWithH){answer.append('H');horizontal--}else{answer.append('V');vertical--;k-=startWithH}};repeat(horizontal){answer.append('H')};repeat(vertical){answer.append('V')};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long combination(int n,int choose){choose=min(choose,n-choose);long long answer=1;for(int i=1;i<=choose;++i)answer=answer*(n-i+1)/i;return answer;}public:string kthSmallestPath(vector<int>& destination,int k){int vertical=destination[0],horizontal=destination[1];string answer;while(horizontal&&vertical){long long startWithH=combination(horizontal+vertical-1,vertical);if(k<=startWithH){answer+='H';--horizontal;}else{answer+='V';--vertical;k-=startWithH;}}answer+=string(horizontal,'H');answer+=string(vertical,'V');return answer;} };
